overview_description.description: OpenFarming.Earth is an AI-powered food distribution and supply-chain platform focused on helping food distributors automate order aggregation, inventory management, demand forecasting, routing, and payment workflows. The company mainly targets distributors, wholesalers, restaurants, hotels, and grocery supply chains in the Middle East.
